programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

actor: King Aegon II Targaryen - Tom Glynn-Carney
Lord Corlys 'The Sea Snake' Velaryon - Steve Toussaint

programs.title: First Man
programs.desc: The 1960s, the times of the Cold War.The USA and the USSR are engaged in an arms race.The competition also concerns the conquest of space.Test pilot and astronaut Neil Armstrong leads the pioneering Gemini 8 mission, which marks the first-ever docking of two spacecraft in orbit.The test does not go according to plan, as the daredevils lose control of the connected machines.Their lives hang in the balance.However, Neil demonstrates extraordinary skills and self-control, thanks to which he and his companion, David Scott, successfully return to Earth.A year after the tragedy of the Apollo 1 crew, who died during the launch simulation, Armstrong becomes commander of the Apollo 11 mission. It will go down in history.Its goal is to land a man on the Moon.

programs.title: Lord Of The Flies
programs.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programs.title: Dope Girls
programs.sub_title: A Filthy Little Mole Down a Filthy Little Hole
programs.desc: A widowed single mother, Kate is perceived by those around her as a calm person with conservative views.To provide for his family, he decides to take a surprising step - he opens a nightclub.

programs.title: A Very Royal Scandal
programs.desc: November 2019. After the suicide of Jeffrey Epstein, convicted of sex crimes, Prince Andrew (Michael Sheen), the son of Elizabeth II, decides to give an interview to journalist Emily Maitlis (Ruth Wilson), host of the evening program "Newsnight".The aristocrat hopes to clear the air around him, as there are numerous media reports about his acquaintance with an American billionaire and even accusations that he had sex with 17-year-old alleged human trafficking victim Virginia Giuffre.The interview lasts 49 minutes, but an intelligent journalist does not need that much time to make her guest confess.His words, among others:that she does not regret knowing Epstein causes a storm.The film is about a real event.

programs.title: 4 from there
programs.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programs.title: The Outrun
programs.desc: A young woman named Rona (Saoirse Ronan), who has recently left an addiction treatment center, returns from London to her native Scotland, to one of the islands of the Orkney archipelago.Because her parents are separated, she lives alternately with her mother, where she meets with her religious friends, and with her father, whom she helps on the farm.At the same time, she is still trying to cope with difficult memories - the beginning of her stay in London, where she started studying biology and often went to clubs with her boyfriend Daynin (Paapa Essiedu).She didn't even notice when she fell into alcoholism, which led to problems in her relationship and began to destroy her life.Meanwhile, while staying on the island, Rona decides to return to London.However, already on the ferry he feels that he is unable to control the urge to drink alcohol.He must re-plan his life.

programs.title: Last Swim
programs.desc: Ziba (Deba Hekmat), whose family comes from Iran, lives in London and is an ambitious young woman.However, she hides a painful secret that none of her friends know about.Ziba has just gotten into university, where she is going to study astrophysics.On this occasion, he meets with his friends: Tara (Lydia Fleming), Shea (Solly McLeod) and Merf (Jay Lycurgo), with whom he intends to celebrate this event.She feels irritated when she learns that they are to be joined by a promising young football player, Malcolm (Denzel Baidoo), whom she does not know.Soon, however, an event occurs that makes him emotionally closer to her than her long-time friends.The future for both of them is not as bright as it might seem.Sasha Nathwani's feature-length directorial debut.

programs.title: Killer Heat
programs.desc: Greece.American Nick Bali (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) is hired to investigate the circumstances of the death of young shipping magnate Leo Vardakis (Richard Madden) in Crete.The deceased's sister-in-law, Penelope Vardakis (Shailene Woodley), does not believe the official police report.A private detective discovers that sunny landscapes hide many dark secrets and anyone can be a suspect.He discovers further facts about the rich and influential Vardakis family, as well as the brothers' complicated relationship.Adaptation of the story "The Jealousy Man" by Jo Nesbo.

programs.title: Neuilly-Poissy
programs.desc: Daniel (Max Boublil) is a successful entrepreneur.He successfully combines running a business with a successful family life.However, when financial irregularities are discovered in his company, he is forced to exchange a luxurious apartment in the city of Neuilly for a cell in the prison in Poissy.From one day to the next, he finds himself in a world whose rules he does not understand.Moreover, he is a Jew and now he will be hanging out with Muslims.However, thanks to his sense of humor and the ability to cope with difficult situations, Daniel tries to adapt to the new reality.
